summary: An isometric click-to-move action RPG slice with two full classes, a seeded wilderness and three-floor crypt, ten enemy families, two multi-phase bosses, affix loot with crafting, IndexedDB saves, Veteran difficulty and Target Hunt — all assets procedural.
notes: Core loop is completed end to end by an autopilot in the test suite, and the production build was toured in headless Edge from a sub-path with no console errors; no human playtest, and frame rate on real GPUs is unverified. Combat in the browser tour was driven through simulation intents, not real pointer events. node scripts/screenshot.mjs needs a system Edge or Chrome.
